turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’ve been feeling very fatigued for about six months, and I’ve lost around 5 kilograms without trying, even though my appetite has stayed good. I’m generally otherwise well—no fevers, night sweats, or changes in my bowel or bladder habits.”

turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any changes in my eyesight—no blurriness, dark spots, or loss of vision. My main issue has been the ongoing fatigue and the unintentional weight loss despite my appetite staying the same.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t smoke and I haven’t used tobacco in the past.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
